events.text: Prince Alexander passed a qualifying examination to become service cadet in the Royal Navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: passed a qualifying examination to become service cadet in the Royal Navy in March 1902

events.text: Prince Alexander joined the cadet training ship HMS Britannia at Dartmouth.
events.subject: self
events.quote: joined the cadet training ship HMS Britannia at Dartmouth on 8 May 1902

events.text: Prince Alexander served in the Royal Navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He served in the Royal Navy from 1902 to 1908

events.text: Prince Alexander's service in the Royal Navy ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He served in the Royal Navy from 1902 to 1908

events.text: Prince Alexander became one of the earliest members of The Castaways Club.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1910 , became one of the earliest members of The Castaways Club
